enonce_intro_markdown:
A bag contains 3 ripe mangoes and 2 unripe mangoes. Two mangoes are drawn out of the bag at random one after another without replacement.

Find the probability that

questions.corrige_markdown:
There are $3$ ripe mangoes among $5$ in the bag.

$P(\text{first ripe})=\dfrac35$.

**Answer: $\dfrac35$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) both mangoes are unripe *[5 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
First draw unripe: $\dfrac25$. Without replacement, $4$ mangoes remain, $1$ of them unripe: second draw unripe $\dfrac14$.

$P(\text{both unripe})=\dfrac25\times\dfrac14=\dfrac{2}{20}=\dfrac1{10}$.

**Answer: $\dfrac1{10}$.**
